summary: Add TPA Group as an Account Type

description.raw: As a Claims Manager I want  TPA Group  added as a value in the Account Type picklist So that accounts representing a group of TPAs can be classified correctly within Salesforce. Scenario 1: Add TPA Group to Account Type picklist   Given the Account object contains a picklist field named "Type"   When the picklist values are updated   Then "TPA Group" must be added as an available value in the picklist Scenario 2: Restrict Account Type to approved values only   Given "TPA Group" is now part of the approved values   When a user selects a value for Account Type   Then only approved values, including "TPA Group", may be selected   And any unapproved value must be rejected Scenario 3: Integration and automation alignment   Given Account Type is referenced in automation, reporting, and integrations   When "TPA Group" is added as a picklist value   Then these processes must recognise and accept "TPA Group" as a valid Account Type
